decisions.reason: Transactional email is a core, home-page-featured cloud service with usage-based revenue and strong fit to the firm's messaging strategy.
Managed capture services have a dedicated page and documented customer adoption, and they support the firm's push into electronic document workflows.
Email-to-fax conversion is cheap to maintain on existing infrastructure and serves regulated customers who still rely on fax.
The fax delivery optimization feature is closely tied to the established fax business and costs little to keep, though it could be absorbed into the main fax offer.
Sandbox threat protection is increasingly important in email security and complements the firm's secure messaging portfolio.
